subject: Cross-clock demo mismatch — request to rebook multi-region kickoff
body:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Anna Baxter <anna.baxter@bastionhealth.com>, Olivier Dupont <olivier.dupont@medsys.fr>, Kenji Saito <kenji.saito@hiroku.jp>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Cross-clock demo mismatch — request to rebook multi-region kickoff

Hi Anna / Olivier / Kenji,

Thanks again for agreeing to the product kickoff demo next week. I set a single time to simplify scheduling (Tue 2026-04-06 10:00 PDT / 18:00 CET / 02:00 JST) but just realized that daylight savings windows and regional office hours make this awkward for everyone.

Attachment: Bastion_Agenda_v2.pdf (agenda stub)

Quick ask: can you share preferred windows (2 hour blocks) for each participant so we can land a time that doesn't slice into the middle of anyone's night? Naomi and Marissa from our team are copied to help coordinate.

Proposed placeholder: Tue 2026-04-06 14:00 PDT / 22:00 CET / Wed 07:00 JST — I know that's late for EU, so open to alternatives.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.com
+1 415-555-1022

---

From: Anna Baxter <anna.baxter@bastionhealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivier Dupont <olivier.dupont@medsys.fr>, Kenji Saito <kenji.saito@hiroku.jp>
Date: Sun, 29 Mar 2026 10:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Cross-clock demo mismatch — request to rebook multi-region kickoff

Hi Alex — thanks for the note.

We actually moved to summer time in the UK this past weekend so our wall-clock shifted earlier — the 18:00 CET slot you mentioned will now be 19:00 locally for Olivier and me (we're in Paris and London respectively), which pushes us into a late evening. Kenji is also in a strict maintenance window Wed mornings. The single-slot approach is tough.

For Bastion, our ideal slots are: Tue/Wed 14:00–17:00 CET (which is early morning for you in US, but workable) or Thu 09:00–11:00 CET.

Can Naomi or Marissa propose 2–3 options that fit within those EU windows and also accommodate Kenji's JST constraints?

Thanks,
Anna Baxter
Director of Platform, Bastion Health
anna.baxter@bastionhealth.com

---

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Anna Baxter <anna.baxter@bastionhealth.com>, Olivier Dupont <olivier.dupont@medsys.fr>, Kenji Saito <kenji.saito@hiroku.jp>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Cross-clock demo mismatch — request to rebook multi-region kickoff

Hi all — copying our scheduling grid (Timezone-table.csv attached) and three candidate slots that try to avoid middle-of-night for anyone:

Option A: Wed 2026-04-07 07:00 PDT / 15:00 CET / 23:00 JST (late for Kenji but within support window)
Option B: Thu 2026-04-08 08:00 PDT / 16:00 CET / 00:00 JST (crosses midnight for Kenji)
Option C: Thu 2026-04-08 11:00 PDT / 19:00 CET / 03:00 JST (late EU, not ideal)

If we must keep Kenji earlier local time, we can shift to Fri morning in APAC which will be late afternoon EU and very early for us in the US — tradeoffs either way.

Action: please indicate first and second preference (A/B/C) and whether we should split the demo into two shorter region-specific sessions (EU+APAC and US only).

Attachment: Timezone-table.csv (CSV stub showing time conversions and DST offsets)

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Principal Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

---

From: Olivier Dupont <olivier.dupont@medsys.fr>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Baxter <anna.baxter@bastionhealth.com>, Kenji Saito <kenji.saito@hiroku.jp>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 16:45:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Cross-clock demo mismatch — request to rebook multi-region kickoff

Thanks Naomi — Option A looks best for Olivier and Anna (15:00 CET). Kenji, can you confirm if 23:00 JST is acceptable on Wed, otherwise we should consider splitting (EU/APAC and a separate US session).

On that note, Bastion would prefer a single 60–75 minute session if we can avoid asking executives to join past 19:30 local. If not, two 45-minute sessions is OK.

If everyone confirms A as first choice, Alex — can you resend a calendar invite for Wed 2026-04-07 07:00 PDT / 15:00 CET / 23:00 JST and mark as tentative until Kenji confirms? We'll need the agenda and the Doc link (HubSpot/Doc) in the invite.

Best,
Olivier Dupont
Head of IT Architecture, MedSys (Bastion partner)
olivier.dupont@medsys.fr

---

>
> Can you please record? If we need more hands-on follow-up, schedule an APAC-only office hours slot on Fri morning JST.
>
> Thanks,
> Kenji
